estilo.subtitulo: Deterministic, verifiable writing suggestions. Nothing changes until you accept a specific finding.
estilo.sin_propuesta: No automatic rewrite: review the fragment manually.
estilo.ninguno: No style findings in the analyzed text.
estilo.seleccione: Select a finding to see its details.
estilo.sin_documento: Import a document to review its style.
estilo.desactivado_en: The document appears to be in English. This review uses Spanish lexicons, so the module is turned off rather than applying rules meant for another language.
estilo.desactivado_indeterminado: There is not enough Spanish text to review its style.
estilo.excluidos: Not analyzed: quoted passages, block quotes, references, headings, tables or figure captions.
estilo.aplicados: {n} change(s) were applied to a new working copy. The original document was not modified.
estilo.rechazado: Finding rejected; it will not be shown again in this session.
regla.muletilla.exp: “{excerpt}” is a filler phrase: it announces something instead of saying it. Proposed: remove it. Threshold: {umbral} occurrence.
regla.pleonasmo.exp: “{excerpt}” repeats an idea; the short form says the same. Threshold: {umbral} occurrence.
regla.adjetivo_vacio.exp: There are {ocurrencias} evaluative adjectives in {palabras} analyzed words ({medido} per 1000; threshold {umbral}). Consider replacing “{excerpt}” with a concrete supporting fact.
regla.intensificador.exp: There are {ocurrencias} intensifiers in {palabras} analyzed words ({medido} per 1000; threshold {umbral}). “{excerpt}” rarely adds precision.
regla.repeticion.exp: Words with the approximate stem “{raiz}” appear {medido} times in this {palabras}-word paragraph (threshold {umbral}): {formas}. The stem is approximate; check that it is the same word.
regla.oracion_larga.exp: The sentence has {medido} words (threshold {umbral}). Long sentences are harder to follow; a split point is proposed when there is a clear one.
regla.prosa_uniforme.exp: The {oraciones} analyzed sentences average {media} words with a standard deviation of {medido} (threshold: below {umbral}). Mixing short and long sentences helps reading. The first sentence is marked as a reference.
regla.pasiva.exp: {pasivas} of {oraciones} sentences ({medido} %; threshold {umbral} %) appear to be passive. This one names the agent (“por …”): the active voice is usually more direct.
regla.pasiva.exp_legitima: {pasivas} of {oraciones} sentences ({medido} %; threshold {umbral} %) appear to be passive. This one does not say who acts: in APA this is legitimate when the agent does not matter. Information only.
regla.nominalizacion.exp: “{excerpt}” turns a verb into a noun. Using the verb directly usually shortens the sentence. Threshold: {umbral} occurrence.
